reply:
[Download the printable kitchen pantry kit](<<TEMP>/T/selfrec-work-<SESSION>/Kitchen pantry kit.pdf>)

Print both pages **single-sided on plain paper**. Tape page 1 to the refrigerator door. Cut out the five labels on page 2 for the three personal shelves, the shared shelf, and the giveaway basket. Write each housemate’s name beside the same number on their shelf and on the fridge.

Use one painter’s-tape marker per staple. When something runs low, move its marker to **LOW**. Whoever takes that shopping job moves the marker under their number, then returns it to **STOCKED** once the item is back on the shelf.
